description: This file implements a flag forwarding mechanism for subprocesses in a C++ project, utilizing gflags for flag management, and includes classes and functions for dynamic flag registration, XML parsing of flag info, and subprocess command execution.

classes.name: SubprocessFlag
classes.description: Superclass representing a flag loaded from another process, holding subprocess and flag name information.

classes.name: DynamicFlag
classes.description: Template class for dynamically registering a gflags flag of a specific type, subclassing SubprocessFlag.

methods.name: CurrentFlagsToTypes
methods.description: Returns a map of current flag names to their types as strings.

methods.name: xmlChildWithName
methods.description: Returns the child XML node with a specific name.

methods.name: xmlContent
methods.description: Extracts and returns the text content of an XML node.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a specified type T.

methods.name: MakeDynamicFlag
methods.description: Creates a dynamic flag object based on flag info and subprocess.

methods.name: FlagsForSubprocess
methods.description: Parses XML help output to extract flag information for a subprocess.

methods.name: FlagForwarder
methods.description: Class responsible for forwarding flags to subprocesses, updating defaults, and managing flag arguments.

methods.name: UpdateFlagDefaults
methods.description: Updates the default values of flags in subprocesses based on current global flags.

methods.name: ArgvForSubprocess
methods.description: Generates argument vector for a subprocess based on current flags and input args.
